hint.total: Animation plus hold stays under {max} seconds
status.hd_queued: Waiting for the render queue to take your HD video…
status.hd_running: Rendering your HD video. This takes longer than a preview.
status.cached: Already rendered. Playing the saved copy.
status.saving: Your HD video is ready. The browser is saving the file.
status.press_play: Your video is ready. Press play.
status.cancelled: Cancelled. Nothing was lost: your settings are still here.
error.unreachable: The app is not answering. Close the app and open it again.
error.http: The app answered with an error instead of a result. The code was HTTP {status}.
error.host_not_allowed: This app only answers its own interface on this machine. A request from somewhere else is refused.
error.ui_file_missing: Part of this app is missing from the install, so the page cannot open. Try reinstalling it.
error.ui_url_unknown: This app has no page at that address, so nothing could be opened. Reload the app's own address.
error.render_failed: The video could not be rendered
error.render_timeout: The render took too long and was stopped
error.render_output_missing: The render finished but left no video file. Try again, and check the app's log if it repeats.
error.manim_missing: Manim is not installed here, so nothing can be rendered
error.ffmpeg_missing: No FFmpeg was found here, so nothing can be encoded
error.cache_key_invalid: This app could not name that render, so it did not start one. Try again.
error.cache_path_outside_output_dir: This app cannot reach its own render folder, so it did not start one. Check that the data folder still exists.
error.quality_mismatch: That request asked for one quality and carried another. Pick a quality and try again.
error.job_not_found: This app no longer knows about that render job
error.video_not_found: The finished video is no longer in this app's cache. Generate it again.
error.video_name_invalid: That file name is not one this app produces. There is nothing to serve.
error.file_name_invalid: The render left a file this app cannot name or serve. Try again.
error.params_not_json: The settings did not arrive as data, so nothing was rendered. Press Try again.
error.params_not_object: The settings did not arrive as one block of data, so nothing was rendered. Press Try again.
error.params_invalid: One setting has a value this app does not accept. Check the form and press Try again.
error.params_field_unknown: A setting this app does not know was sent, so nothing was rendered. Press Try again.
error.text_empty: The text is empty. Type something to animate.
error.text_invalid: The text has to be written, not a number or an object. Type it into the box.
error.text_too_long: The text is {got} characters. Use at most {max}.
error.too_many_lines: The text has {got} lines. Use at most {max}.
error.text_control_character: The text holds an invisible control character. Retype that line.
error.animation_invalid: That animation is not one this app offers. Pick one from the list and try again.
error.animation_duration_invalid: The animation length has to be a number of seconds. Type it into the box.
error.animation_duration_out_of_range: The animation length must be between {min} and {max} seconds. Shorten it and try again.
error.hold_duration_invalid: The hold length has to be a number of seconds. Type it into the box.
error.hold_duration_out_of_range: The hold length must be between {min} and {max} seconds. Shorten it and try again.
error.font_invalid: That font is not one this app can use. Pick one from the list and try again.
error.font_size_invalid: The text size has to be a whole number. Type it without a decimal point.
error.font_size_out_of_range: The text size must be between {min} and {max}. Change it and try again.
error.text_color_invalid: The text color must be a hex color like #1A2B3C. Pick it again.
error.outline_color_invalid: The outline color must be a hex color like #1A2B3C. Pick it again.
error.outline_width_invalid: The outline width has to be a number. Type it into the box.
error.outline_width_out_of_range: The outline width must be between {min} and {max}. Change it and try again.
error.background_invalid: The background has to be one setting with a type and a color. Pick it again.
error.background_type_invalid: That background type is not one this app offers. Pick one from the list.
error.background_type_unsupported: Transparent backgrounds are not available yet. Pick a solid color.
error.quality_invalid: That quality is not one this app offers. Pick Preview or HD.
error.total_duration_too_long: Animation plus hold must stay under {max} seconds
